name: lif-workflow
description: Cross-repository workflow for LIF coding agents: session handoff (handoff, pickup, plan-handoff), planning and backlog (structured-planning, backlog, seed, retro), single-issue and PR loops (issue-implement, issue-review, pr-shepherd), Codex fanout (codex), Herdr workspaces per repo (herdr-workspace), Claude Code reference (claude-code-docs, claude-code-reviewer), vault conventions (obsidian-vault), skill authoring (skill-designer), personal utilities (morning-briefing, markdown-to-docx, wechat-auto), and PreToolUse/PostToolUse safety and formatting hooks.
